World Cup exits spark fan and team discussions

Following the FIFA World Cup, fans in Kolkata reflected on Brazil's exit and Neymar's potential retirement. Meanwhile, discussions are ongoing regarding England's team strategies and player performance, particularly concerning Ravi Bishnoi and Sanju Samson's roles in recent matches. Educational institutions are also exploring ways to integrate the excitement of the World Cup into learning.
